タイトル: Reliable and Easy-to-Manage Business Phone System
投稿者: Nigel カナダのCCO 運輸、トラック、鉄道, 5,001～10,000人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Reliable and Easy-to-Manage Business Phone System"
良い点: Zoom Phone has been a reliable and user-friendly business phone solution. The integration with the broader Zoom platform makes it easy to manage calls, voicemail, messaging, and meetings from a single interface. Call quality is consistently strong, and features such as call queues, auto attendants, call recording, and voicemail transcription help improve efficiency in a busy customer service environment. The administrative tools are straightforward, making it easy to manage users and phone settings across teams.
改善点: While the platform is easy to use overall, some advanced administrative settings can require additional training to fully understand. Reporting and analytics are functional but could offer more customization and detailed insights. At times, navigating between phone, chat, and meeting settings can be slightly confusing for new users.

タイトル: Solid cloud phone but needs polish
投稿者: 認証済みレビュアー 認証済みLinkedInユーザー 資本市場, 11～50人規模の会社 使用期間： 2年以上 共有 "Solid cloud phone but needs polish"
良い点: Super easy to set up and integrates perfectly with Zoom Meetings – everything's in one app. Call quality is generally clear, and I love the voicemail transcription and call recording features. The mobile app works great too, so I can take work calls anywhere. Admin dashboard is simple to manage users and numbers, and the pricing is competitive for what you get.
改善点: The call quality can get spotty when internet is unstable, and there's no fallback to cellular, which is frustrating during important calls. International calling rates are expensive, and SMS is limited compared to competitors. Also, basic features like call parking and busy lamp fields aren't as smooth as traditional phone systems, which annoys power users.

改善点: It is sometimes confusing to accept a call with your mobile app while you are connected on your computer. Besides that, I do not experience any issued with the App.

良い点: Zoom phone is a great tool for having group meetings. I have been attending online classes with Zoom phone for the last year. It is very easy to share and present from your phone.
改善点: This software can be tough to see others when you are presenting. When you are the presenter, you may not be able to see other participants.
